calibration.note: All Seshat cases participate as authoritative calibration anchors. Former geographic holdouts are no longer independent validation. Independent English wheat remains excluded. Shared crop-family factors only; no cell-specific yield edits.
calibration.round: 3: all comparable Seshat estimates and propagated anchor intervals are mandatory enclosure constraints, user-authorized

units.area: best occurring suitability class, not whole-cell mean
units.annualization_status: Inferred from Module II and separate Module V annual-production tabulations; exact product fallow flag unavailable

sensitivity.note: One-at-a-time accounting sensitivity, not evidence that an extra crop is seasonally feasible.
